title: StudioBrain engine/framework declaration
description: Preferred-or-required execution engine for a provider entry or a platform default (SBAI-7974). `category` MUST reuse model-manager's engines.schema.json v2 `taxonomy_category` enum. This is NOT `wire` — wire is the protocol (openai-compat, anthropic, …). Drift-prevention: never invent a new category here without adding it to registry/engines.schema.json in studiobrain-model-manager first.

requirement.description: preferred = executor may fall through to another engine/framework when this one cannot run. required = executor must use this category (or dead-end honestly). Never silently spill to a paid/cloud lane.

framework.description: Optional more-specific engine/runtime id (transformers.js, litert-lm, llama-server, onnx-inprocess, …). Not a closed enum so it can match MM engines.json ids and in-app runtimes without a schema PR for every new engine.

taxonomy_category.description: model-manager engines.schema.json v2 taxonomy_category. Keep this enum byte-identical to that schema.
